developments.facts: Official 10–2 decision maintains 3.75–4.00%. Cook and Hammack preferred a 25 bp hike. Activity is described as expanding at a strong pace, versus solid in September. Inflation remains elevated; more information will help determine the appropriate policy stance. There is no explicit December commitment.

developments.title: OBR energy-import shock, real incomes and fiscal exposure
developments.facts: The official October outlook describes a negative energy terms-of-trade shock. Central growth is around 1.25% in 2026 and 1% in 2027; 2027 is about half a percentage point below March. developments.title: Treasury auction and NYFed results distinguish awards from caps
developments.facts: TreasuryDirect confirms CUSIP 91282CRS2 is a two-year floating-rate note: $30 billion offered, $30.0000248 billion par awarded inside the offering plus $3.3335517 billion outside it, bid-to-cover 3.05 and high discount margin 0.038%. Its October 28 11:30 AM Eastern close is distinct from the record update. The 17-week bill reports bid-to-cover 3.08; these do not establish FX flows. NYFed October 28 results show $3 million accepted in each of its two standing-repo operations and $176 million in reverse repo; routine implementation is not QE. developments.facts: The official October outlook describes a negative energy terms-of-trade shock. Central growth is around 1.25% in 2026 and 1% in 2027; 2027 is about half a percentage point below March. It projects CPI around 3.5% in 2027 and lower real disposable income than previously forecast. Fiscal consolidation is delayed, but the 2029-30 current-budget rule retains a GBP15 billion margin. Morgan analysis says the budget met fiscal-restraint expectations, gilts slightly outperformed peers and sterling received modest support. It reports substantial expected BoE tightening but no new BoE commitment. The delivered reassurance challenges using structural growth/fiscal headwinds alone as the current-session direction.
